summary: It's represent a scalable, robust and mathematically valid solution for mining all sky infrared survey by transforming traditional visual astronomy into a standardizes deed learning tensor operation involving CNN , MAX POOLING, Bi LSTM , AND Softmax classification this architecture shifts the field of outer solar system exploration from reactive discovery to proper active automated identification.•
details: The identification of faint , high proper motion trand neptunian objects , colloquially referred to as "planet X", present a monumental data processing challenge due to the multi epoch scale of all sky survey. This page introduces my project , an automated multi layer deep learning framework designed to isolated moving celestial bodies from NASA sphere X near infrared data set. Instead of executing resources intensive operations on raw full framework FITS image the framework compress multi epoch astrometric point source catalog into a standardizes spatial temporal tensor matrix (X). We implement a pipeline consisting of 1D convolutional neural network for background stellar filtering, max pooling for velocity shift amplification, a bidirectional long short term memory network for bidirectional trajectory analysis and a soft max classification layer this integrated network successfully cancels out stable background stellar signature and automated the discovery of low luminosity brown dwarfs rogue planetary bodies and high proper motion transient with high predictive confidence.
